ledger.name: Polder
ledger.expectedEffect: Selects Polder signature traits and a 4-point purchased-trait budget; ancestry does not fix culture.

ledger.name: Polder Traits
ledger.expectedEffect: 4 ancestry points; selected costs 1 + 1 + 2 = 4.

ledger.name: Shadowmeld
ledger.expectedEffect: Grants Shadowmeld ability, not an always-on hidden state.

ledger.name: Small!
ledger.expectedEffect: Size 1S replaces ordinary size 1M.

ledger.name: Corruption Immunity
ledger.expectedEffect: Corruption immunity level + 2 = 3; sourced static immunity feeds existing generic damage facts. Feature-specific triggered damage remains outside this contribution.

ledger.name: Graceful Retreat
ledger.expectedEffect: Disengage shift distance +1; ordinary 1 becomes 2.

ledger.name: Fearless
ledger.expectedEffect: Cannot be made frightened; expose immunity, do not reject deliberate manual condition overrides.

ledger.name: Urban / Alertness
ledger.expectedEffect: One interpersonal or intrigue skill; Alertness is intrigue.

ledger.name: Communal / Gymnastics
ledger.expectedEffect: One crafting or exploration skill; Gymnastics is exploration.

ledger.name: Creative / Tailoring
ledger.expectedEffect: Music, Perform, or one crafting skill; Tailoring is crafting. Empathize is not eligible here.

ledger.name: Culture edge
ledger.expectedEffect: Edge on tests to recall lore about the culture or influence/interact with its people; Culture Benefits heading.

ledger.name: Caelian / Khoursirian / The First Language
ledger.expectedEffect: Caelian automatically known; Khoursirian culture language; First Language career language; both appear in Languages by Ancestry, not the dead-language table.

ledger.name: Mage's Apprentice
ledger.expectedEffect: Fixed Magic; two other lore skills Monsters and Timescape; one language; renown +1; supernatural perk Arcane Trick; Forgotten Memories incident.

ledger.name: Duplicate fixed Magic / Empathize
ledger.expectedEffect: Choosing Skills permits any-group replacement for same specific skill granted from two sources. Keep career and class fixed Magic provenance; grant one effective Magic and one Empathize replacement. Q-CHAR-11 forbids manufacturing replacements via optional duplicate choices.

ledger.name: Arcane Trick
ledger.expectedEffect: Grants the Arcane Trick main action; seven cosmetic/minor utility options, no rolled damage or permanent numeric bonus.

ledger.name: Elementalist
ledger.expectedEffect: Reason 2; assign array 2,1,1,-1 to Intuition2 Agility1 Presence1 Might-1. Stamina18, Recoveries8, potency R-2/R-1/R. Fixed Magic plus three crafting/lore skills Alchemy, Blacksmithing, History.

ledger.name: Elemental Specialization
ledger.expectedEffect: Choose Fire; grants Acolyte of Fire and Fire specialization level-one feature/triggered action.

ledger.name: 1st-Level Specialization Feature
ledger.expectedEffect: Fire grants Return to Formlessness.

ledger.name: Specialization Triggered Action
ledger.expectedEffect: Fire grants Explosive Assistance.

ledger.name: Essence
ledger.expectedEffect: Resource identity Essence. Start encounter gain Victories, turn start +2, first qualifying non-untyped/non-holy damage within10 each round +1, lose remaining at encounter end. Generation/reset remain manual. Existing generic outside-combat cost waiver applies, with once-use-until-Victory/respite restriction shown. Starting new hero Essence0.

ledger.name: Hurl Element permission
ledger.expectedEffect: Hurl Element may be used as a ranged free strike; this wrapper permission is not printed in the ability-only extraction.

ledger.name: Persistent Magic
ledger.expectedEffect: Maintain immediately; reduces essence gained at turn start by Persistent value, cannot make gain negative; damage >=5R=10 in one turn stops all; ends encounter; voluntary stop no action; no duplicate effect on one creature.

ledger.name: Enchantment
ledger.expectedEffect: Choose one, Destruction; change with ward by respite ritual. No kit granted.

ledger.name: Enchantment of Destruction
ledger.expectedEffect: +1 rolled damage with all Magic abilities, including Area abilities; never flat damage without a power roll.

ledger.name: Elementalist Ward
ledger.expectedEffect: Choose one, Ward of Delightful Consequences; change with enchantment by respite ritual.

ledger.name: Ward of Delightful Consequences
ledger.expectedEffect: First damage taken each round grants1 surge; no permanent stamina or defense bonus; no automatic surge generation in this slice.

ledger.name: Fire: Acolyte of Fire
ledger.expectedEffect: +1 rolled damage with both Fire and Magic; also Hurl Element when dealing fire. Stacks with Destruction for total+2 on selected Fire spells, never on nonrolled Practical Magic.

ledger.name: Elementalist Abilities
ledger.expectedEffect: Choose two signatures, one3-Essence and one5-Essence ability; selectable across specializations, support subset explicit.

ledger.name: Shadowmeld
ledger.expectedEffect: Maneuver Self Magic. Shadow against touched surface; conditional hiding, enemy strike/search bane, cannot move/be forced or act except listed exceptions; larger areas only if affect surface; exit maneuver; destroyed surface ends form and deals irreducible1d6.

ledger.name: Arcane Trick
ledger.expectedEffect: Main action Self Magic, seven utility options; no rolled damage.

ledger.name: Hurl Element
ledger.expectedEffect: Main action Ranged10 Magic Strike one creature/object; roll R; source tiers2+R/4+R/6+R; choose acid/cold/corruption/fire/lightning/poison/sonic. Destruction+1; Acolyte another+1 only fire.

ledger.name: Practical Magic
ledger.expectedEffect: Maneuver Magic: Knockback at Hurl range10 using R; OR flat R2 elemental damage within10; OR teleport R2 plus1 square per Essence. Damage2 has no rolled bonuses.

ledger.name: Return to Formlessness
ledger.expectedEffect: Main action Fire Magic Melee1 mundane object; destroy touched square of larger object. No damage roll.

ledger.name: Explosive Assistance
ledger.expectedEffect: Triggered (not free) Fire Magic Ranged10 Self/ally when target force moves; +R2 movement distance, spend1 Essence for +2R4 instead. No damage roll.

ledger.name: Bifurcated Incineration
ledger.expectedEffect: Signature Main action Fire Magic Ranged Strike; Ranged10 two creatures/objects; roll+R2, base2/4/6 plus2 rolled bonuses =>4/6/8 fire. R is NOT added to damage.

ledger.name: Viscous Fire
ledger.expectedEffect: Signature Main action Fire Magic Ranged Strike; Ranged10 one creature/object; roll+R2, base2+R/5+R/7+R plus2 =>6/9/11 fire; push2/3/4.

ledger.name: The Flesh, a Crucible
ledger.expectedEffect: 3 Essence Main action Fire Magic Ranged Strike; Ranged10 one creature/object; roll+R2,5+R/8+R/11+R plus2=>9/12/15 fire; Persistent1 reroll at start of turn in range, no action/Essence spend.

ledger.name: Conflagration
ledger.expectedEffect: 5 Essence Main action Area Fire Magic Ranged; 3cube within10 each enemy; roll+R2, base4/6/10 plus2=>6/8/12 fire; Persistent2 use maneuver at turn start to repeat free of Essence.

ledger.name: Melee Weapon Free Strike
ledger.expectedEffect: Main action Charge Melee Strike Weapon; Melee1 creature/object; choose M or A, optimal A1 gives3/6/8. No Magic bonus.

ledger.name: Ranged Weapon Free Strike
ledger.expectedEffect: Main action Ranged Strike Weapon; Ranged5 creature/object; choose M or A, optimal A1 gives3/5/7. No Magic bonus.
